clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.approved_clause: Mutual aggregate liability is capped at fees paid or payable under this SOW; indirect, consequential and special damages are excluded except where the MSA expressly says otherwise.

clauses.title: Acceptance
clauses.approved_clause: Deliverables are accepted against written acceptance criteria; the client has five business days to reject with specific defects; silence after the review period is deemed acceptance only where objective criteria are defined.

clauses.title: IP ownership
clauses.approved_clause: Pre-existing materials, accelerators and know-how remain provider property; after payment, the client receives a license to use deliverables for internal business purposes.

clauses.title: Payment terms
clauses.approved_clause: Fees are billed by milestone or monthly in arrears as stated in this SOW; undisputed invoices are due net 30; taxes and reimbursable expenses are excluded unless listed.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.approved_clause: Either party may terminate for uncured material breach after notice and cure period; client pays for services performed and approved non-cancellable commitments through the effective date.

clauses.title: Warranty and disclaimer
clauses.approved_clause: Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner; except for express SOW warranties, all other warranties are disclaimed to the extent permitted.

clauses.title: Change control
clauses.approved_clause: Changes to scope, timing, dependencies, assumptions or fees require a written change order signed by authorized representatives before work proceeds.

clauses.title: Data protection
clauses.approved_clause: Each party follows the data protection addendum and agreed security schedule; data-related remedies and indemnities remain subject to the MSA/SOW liability framework unless QRM approves otherwise.
